topics.title: New Custodes Statlines & Rules Reveals – Meta Impact
topics.what_is_driving_it: Official Custodes rules preview showing significant stat changes and unit removals generating high engagement on tactics channels
topics.relevance_note: Live competitive meta shift happening now; multiple creator reactions indicate this is actively reshaping army building strategies

topics.title: The Lion Returns – Dark Angels Chapter Rules & Primarch Mechanics
topics.what_is_driving_it: Lion El'Jonson rules reveal showing 'monstrous' power levels with faction-specific chapter rules driving community theorycrafting
topics.relevance_note: Major primarch release with gameplay asymmetry narrative; high anticipation for Dark Angels faction identity reset

topics.title: Space Marine Release Week Breakdown – What's New & Why It Matters
topics.what_is_driving_it: Major Space Marine product release driving comprehensive coverage and new player interest in Imperium faction
topics.relevance_note: Wide release window creating sustained discussion; entry point for new hobbyists and army starters
topics.gap_note: High search volume but fragmented coverage; opportunity for single authoritative guide video breaking down all new releases, sprues, cost-per-model analysis, and why collectors should care about variants

topics.title: Flying Babies in Warhammer 40K Lore – Cherub Origins & Grimdark Theology
topics.what_is_driving_it: Unusual lore question about Cherubim units generating intrigue with uncommon narrative deep-dive framing
topics.relevance_note: High curiosity signal; viewers drawn to quirky grimdark aspects of 40K worldbuilding that are underexplained in official media
topics.gap_note: True content gap – whimsical but dark 40K lore topics (weird units, obscure factions, body horror explanations) lack quality cinematic explainers. Could own this niche with visually-driven lore breakdowns of '40K's strangest units'

topics.title: Kill Team Tournament & Competitive Play – Zero Experience Entry
topics.what_is_driving_it: Narrative-driven tournament entry content showing Kill Team as accessible competitive format for new players
topics.relevance_note: Growing Kill Team community; viewers interested in competitive pathways and first-tournament anxiety relatable content
topics.gap_note: Content gap: High interest in 'how to compete' content but limited beginner-friendly tournament prep guides. Could dominate with Kill Team beginner tournament prep series (list building, army composition, in-game decision loops)

topics.title: Metallic Paint Showdown 2026 – Ionic vs Vallejo vs Competitors
topics.what_is_driving_it: Technical paint comparison video addressing recurring hobbyist question about best metallics for miniatures
topics.relevance_note: Painters actively seeking guidance on paint products; this is a solved problem but content performs well with audience
topics.gap_note: Content gap: Painters frequently ask 'what metallic paint should I buy?' but lack comprehensive side-by-side application tutorials. Could own with comparison series showing wet blending, layering, and sheen differences on actual painted miniatures (not just swatches)

topics.title: Which Airbrush Should I Buy? – Complete Beginner's Guide
topics.what_is_driving_it: Recurring community question about airbrush selection; equipment investment decision causing decision paralysis
topics.relevance_note: High-value hobbyist question with clear monetization angle; decision-making content for mid-level painters leveling up
topics.gap_note: Massive content gap: Thousands asking this question; fragmented answers across forums. Opportunity for 'airbrush buyer's guide' video covering budget tiers ($50-500), maintenance reality check, best for 40K/AoS use cases, and common mistakes. Could include comparison spray tests

topics.title: Warhammer 40K Balance Update Deep Dive – Chaos & Xenos Faction Shifts
topics.what_is_driving_it: Official balance patch (October 2026) affecting competitive meta across multiple factions post-Custodes/Space Marine releases
topics.relevance_note: Immediate relevance for competitive players and list builders; rules changes create tactical content opportunities

topics.title: Golden Demon Reaction & Advanced Painting Techniques – Beginner to Advanced Gap
topics.what_is_driving_it: Beginner painter reacting to elite competition miniatures; bridges aspiration/intimidation gap in hobby skill progression
topics.relevance_note: Relatable content format (reaction) with educational undertone; viewers curious about skill development pathways
topics.gap_note: Content gap: High interest in 'how do I get to Golden Demon level?' but few educational breakdowns of specific techniques used by elite painters. Could own with technique-focused series: 'Golden Demon Techniques Explained – OSL Lighting, NMM, Glazing Mastery'
